title: Trademark clarity and context

location.series: IBM Logo and Brand Guidelines for Third Parties / copyright 2022

slide_intent: Keep the source of a message distinct from the organizations it mentions, because viewers need to understand who is responsible for the offering.
strategic_value: Explicit attribution can protect IBM’s identity from implying a larger role than its actual contribution.
demonstration: A short explanation of potential source confusion leads into two requirements about IBM’s contribution and the communication’s source.
practical_value: Assess whether the mark and accompanying text identify both the sender and IBM’s actual role.

content_islands.name: Context heading
content_islands.spec: Place the two-line heading in the left column.

content_islands.name: Explanation and checks
content_islands.spec: Place the paragraph above two dash-led requirements in the neighboring column.

reference_purposes.Intent: The paragraph explains that viewers must understand the responsibilities and contributions of all parties.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source prohibits use that causes confusion about origin and requires clarity about contribution and communication source.
